name: The Gilded Lady: Life and Love in a Cyborg Shop
source:
Play as Eliza Clemens, a cyborg mechanic (name and appearance customizable), living day-to-day in one of the few remaining cities on Earth. As climate collapse and disease have reshaped society, Eliza's shop, The Gilded Lady, installs cybernetic replacement limbs for sufferers of Neo-leprosy, a devastating redux of that old end-of-days affliction.

But the fragile balance that keeps life survivable is suddenly upset by a technological breakthrough. And Eliza must choose who to face it with.

[From [url=https://veil-of-dust.itch.io/the-gilded-lady-life-and-love-in-a-cyborg-shop]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演伊丽莎·克莱门斯 (Eliza Clemens)，一名半机械人机械师（姓名和外观可自定义），在地球上仅存的几个城市之一中过着日常生活。随着气候崩溃和疾病重塑了社会，伊丽莎的商店“镀金女士”为新麻风病患者安装了控制论替代肢体，这是一种毁灭性的重演，这种古老的末日痛苦再次出现。

但维持生命生存的脆弱平衡突然被技术突破打破。伊丽莎必须选择与谁面对。

[来自[url=https://veil-of-dust.itch.io/the-gilded-lady-life-and-love-in-a-cyborg-shop]Itch.io[/url]]
